summary: Signet Jewelers filed an 8-K reporting an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Goldman Sachs to repurchase $50 million of its common shares. The company made an upfront payment and expects an initial delivery of ~480,000 shares on June 8, 2026. Final settlement is based on VWAP during the calculation period, expected between June 12 and July 17, 2026, with potential adjustments. The ASR is part of Signet's 2017 Share Repurchase Program, leaving ~$355 million in remaining authorization. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This deal represents a capital return via share buyback. Watch for final settlement timing, any adjustments to share delivery, and overall repurchase activity under the remaining authorization.
